purpose: Replace the unattainable conjunction of V77 sampling-sensitive hard checks with one candidate-agnostic global conditional-null p-value. Preserve the actual fresh 32-query group design, retain both sparse and dense anomaly sensitivity, allocate one family-wise error budget across the physical-energy and exact-label rank-coverage blocks, audit calibration on a new bootstrap seed, and stop before candidate construction or fresh payload access.

fresh_query_design.TNG100_fit_train_analogue: randomly permute quota multiset [6,8,9,9] over four fit-train x-z quadrants
fresh_query_design.SIMBA_fit_train_analogue: choose three of eight fit-train realizations and randomly permute quotas [7,10,15]
fresh_query_design.Swift_fit_train_analogue: choose seven of twenty fit-train realizations, assign quota 5 to four and quota 4 to three
fresh_query_design.future_fresh_indices: the immutable metadata-only 32-index selections in V77

independent_audit_phase.source: immutable V73 fit-train summary cache only

q99_999.vector: signed q_delta for TNG100, SIMBA, Swift
q99_999.score: ridge Mahalanobis distance from the V77-calibration center

high_k_power.vector: log(power ratio) for both frozen bands in all three domains

density_PDF.vector: oracle/generated versus truth histogram TV for all three domains

two_point.vector: oracle/generated versus truth KS in 0-1, 1-3, and 3-10 Mpc/h for all three domains

physical_energy_block.ridge_covariance: sample covariance plus identity times max(1e-12, 1e-6 times trace(covariance)/dimension); use Moore-Penrose inverse
physical_energy_block.family_p_value: inclusive upper empirical tail of the family score against the V77 calibration family scores with add-one correction
physical_energy_block.environment_family: upper empirical tail of the number of domains failing the unchanged environment comparison, using the V77 calibration counts; discrete and inclusive
physical_energy_block.energy_family: upper empirical tail of the maximum across domains of standardized candidate-minus-control energy delta; calibration mean and population standard deviation are frozen from V77 calibration
physical_energy_block.sparse_statistic: maximum over the eight values of (-log family_p); parentheses are mandatory and tested
physical_energy_block.dense_statistic: sum over the eight values of (-2 log family_p)
physical_energy_block.sparse_p_value: inclusive upper empirical tail of the sparse statistic against all V77 verification sparse statistics with add-one correction
physical_energy_block.dense_p_value: inclusive upper empirical tail of the dense statistic against all V77 verification dense statistics with add-one correction
physical_energy_block.important_change_from_V77: The old per-component hard intervals and strict candidate-better-than-deterministic conjunction are diagnostic only. Selection uses goodness-of-fit to the compatible truth-oracle null distribution.

rank_coverage_block.method: V76 exact field-level truth-label randomization with separate rank and coverage conditional p-values in each of three domains
rank_coverage_block.block_p_value: min(1, 6*minimum of the six exact-label p-values)
rank_coverage_block.relation_to_V76: The exact statistic and randomization null are unchanged; only the threshold is tightened from 1/120 to 1/240 so the block receives half of one global 0.05 budget.

deterministic_requirements: all frozen provenance, sampler, pairing, shape, and numerical invariants pass
complete_global_rule.complete_candidate_pass: statistical pass and every deterministic requirement pass
complete_global_rule.error_control: Two-level Bonferroni. The physical-energy block adjusts its two omnibus paths; the rank-coverage block adjusts six exact tests; the final factor two allocates one global family-wise 0.05 budget across the two blocks. No independence assumption is required.
complete_global_rule.claim_boundary: This is an empirical compatible-population conditional-null gate plus exact label randomization. Passing is failure to detect the named discrepancies, not proof that the field generator or cosmological inverse is correct.

null_calibration_audit.physical_energy: Evaluate block-p rejection at 0.025 on the new 20,000-row independent audit phase.
null_calibration_audit.complete_pairing: independently resample one physical-energy audit p-value and three rank/coverage p-value pairs from the immutable V76 scenario arrays for each trial
null_calibration_audit.complete_calibrated_if: every scenario has point rejection <=0.05 and Wilson 95-percent upper <=0.055

frozen_power_audit.source: Apply deterministic transformations to the new independent audit-phase continuous metrics; no new cosmological field or candidate is generated.
frozen_power_audit.detection: physical-energy block p <=0.025, equivalently complete global p <=0.05 when the rank-coverage block p is one

alternatives.coherent_q99_999_bias: add +0.15 dex to q_delta in all three domains
alternatives.coherent_Q4_excess: multiply q4_ratio by 1.5 in all three domains
alternatives.coherent_high_k_excess: multiply both high-k band ratios by 1.1 in all three domains
alternatives.coherent_RMS_excess: multiply rms_ratio by 1.1 in all three domains
alternatives.coherent_PDF_TV_excess: add 0.03 to PDF TV in all three domains
alternatives.clear_two_point_KS_excess: add 0.20 to all three two-point KS scales in all three domains
alternatives.environment_failure_all_domains: set the environment failure indicator in all three domains
alternatives.coherent_energy_inferiority: add +0.03 to candidate-minus-control energy delta in all three domains
alternatives.diffuse_multimetric_shift: simultaneously add q_delta +0.075 dex, multiply Q4 by sqrt(1.5), high-k and RMS by sqrt(1.1), add PDF TV +0.015, add two-point KS +0.05, and add energy delta +0.015 in all domains

frozen_power_audit.power_sufficient_if: every named alternative satisfies both minima

select_global_rule_if_all: all four complete null calibration scenarios pass
the implementation exactly satisfies the sparse-parentheses and global-p invariants
predeclared_decision.if_selected_next: Freeze a complete candidate-agnostic V79 gate implementation bound to the V77 fresh indices, then stop for explicit approval before any candidate construction or fresh payload read.
predeclared_decision.if_failed_next: Stop before a complete gate or candidate and report the failed frozen requirement.
